title: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
title_original: 주택임대차계약증서의 확정일자 부여 및 정보제공에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 5 (Public Official in Charge)
(1) Affairs concerning granting fixed dates and providing information thereon shall be handled by a registrar designated pursuant to Article 11 (1) of the Registration of Real Estate Act; where a district court or branch has no registrar, such affairs shall be handled by a court official of at least junior court administrative officer rank designated by the chief judge of the district court or branch: Provided, That granting electronic fixed dates shall be handled by a registrar at a registry office prescribed by Supreme Court Regulation.
(2) Where an application for a fixed date fails to meet requirements prescribed by Supreme Court Regulation, the public official in charge shall notify the applicant of the reason and immediately return the application.
